x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: NeoKolors NKFont CLI Tool - Manage, compile, display, and create TUI fonts.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile an XML font definition (directory or zip) into a compiled binary .nkf font.

arguments.name: XML_PATH
arguments.description: The path to the XML font folder or zip file.

arguments.name: OUTPUT_NKF
arguments.description: The path to save the compiled binary font (.nkf). If omitted, saves using the font's internal name in the current directory.

commands.name: display
commands.description: Display/render the given string using a specified font.

options.name: --horizontal-align
options.description: Horizontal alignment of rendered text (Left, Center, Right). [default: LEFT]

options.name: --vertical-align
options.description: Vertical alignment of rendered text (Top, Center, Bottom). [default: TOP]

options.name: --overflow
options.description: Allow text to overflow outside bounds instead of clipping. [default: False]

options.name: --justify
options.description: Justify text within the available width. [default: False]

options.name: --word-wrap
options.description: Word wrap behavior (None, Hard, Word). [default: WORD]

options.name: --width
options.description: Explicit bounding box width in characters.

options.name: --height
options.description: Explicit bounding box height in rows.

options.name: --hgrad
options.description: Horizontal gradient color stops, comma-separated (e.g. Red,Blue or #FF0000,#00FF00).

options.name: --vgrad
options.description: Vertical gradient color stops, comma-separated (e.g. Red,Blue or #FF0000,#00FF00).

options.name: --proportions
options.description: Font proportions mode: monospaced (mono), variable (var), or kerning.

arguments.name: FONT
arguments.description: A built-in font name, compiled .nkf file, or raw XML font folder/zip.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new blank XML nkfont definition folder structure.

options.name: --all-ascii
options.description: Add all printable ASCII characters to the blank font structure. [default: False]

arguments.name: OUTPUT_DIR
arguments.description: The output directory where the new XML definition will be created.

arguments.name: FONT_NAME
arguments.description: The internal name of the font. If omitted, defaults to the name of the folder.

commands.name: font
commands.description: List all glyphs contained inside a specified font.

arguments.name: FONT
arguments.description: A built-in font name, compiled .nkf file, or raw XML font folder/zip.

commands.name: glyph
commands.description: Inspect a single glyph within a font, showing its properties and rendering it visually.

arguments.name: FONT
arguments.description: A built-in font name, compiled .nkf file, or raw XML font folder/zip.

arguments.name: GLYPH
arguments.description: The character or string ligature representation of the glyph to inspect.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a font file to the tools internal storage.

arguments.name: FONT_PATH
arguments.description: The path to the .flf or .nkf font file to add.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a font from the tools internal storage.

arguments.name: FONT_NAME
arguments.description: The name of the font to remove from internal storage.

commands.name: clean-logs
commands.description: Clean all log files generated by the nkfont tool.
